notes: Roman Wide Field Instrument, detector-averaged curves: arithmetic mean over the 18 SCAs of the owner's per-SCA effective areas (Roman_effarea_v8_SCA01..18_20240301.ecsv, parameters as of 2024-03-01; byte-identical to Roman_effarea_tables_20240327.zip; CC0, https://github.com/RomanSpaceTelescope/roman-technical-information at 14a9b0c). The owner publishes no mean curve; the averaging is NJM's. Transmission = effective area in m^2 divided by 4.374354 m^2 = pi*(2.36 m/2)^2 aperture-stop area (owner MissionandObservatory.yaml); central obscuration not removed. Grism = Grism_1stOrder column; Grism_0thOrder (new band) is the zeroth-order image. Leading/trailing zero samples trimmed to one bounding zero. DetectorType photon from the owner's count-rate zero-point definition; components inferred (effective area = whole system). Per-detector curves: Roman/WFI_SCA01..WFI_SCA18. Replaced on 2026-10-26 the previous NJM curves (SVO FPS copies holding effective area in m^2 of an earlier release), kept as <band>_old.
